typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Current_File as string (),
	Email_Recipeints as string (),
	Filename_XLSX as string (),
	File_Pattern as string (),
	Inbound_Archive_Folder as string (),
	Outbound_Final_Filename as string (),
	Outbound_Folder as string (),
	Outbound_Rename_XLSX as string (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	Source_Folder as string (),
	Source_Full_Path as string (),
	TemplateFileName as string (),
	TemplateFULLFILEPATH as string (),
	Template_Folder as string ()
}

source(output(
		member_id as string,
		enrollment_request_id as string,
		error_reason as string,
		event_type as string,
		action as string,
		Interaction_filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of event_type} = event_type,
		{Copy of error_reason} = error_reason,
		{Copy of enrollment_request_id} = enrollment_request_id,
		{Copy of member_id} = member_id,
		{Copy of action} = action,
		{Copy of Interaction_filename} = Interaction_filename) ~> DataConversion
